solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

indicators.note: during places the torment word in the middle of the enemy word

parts.note: a foe is an enemy
to rag is to tease or torment, as students once ragged a newcomer

explanation.surface: Someone is tormented while the enemy raids their home.
explanation.definitionFit: A foraging trip is a raid in search of food or supplies, a military sense of the word.

clue.text: Fellow reportedly bottling it up when distraught

indicators.note: bottling means holding something inside, like liquid in a bottle
reportedly means we hear a word that sounds like another

parts.note: Frank is a fellow's name; the French coin franc sounds the same

indicators.note: in a down clue up reads the word it from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A man keeps his feelings bottled up when upset.
explanation.walkthrough: FRANC, said like Frank, holds TI, which is IT turned upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone frantic is wild with worry, beside themselves, a synonym of distraught.

definitions.meaning: a working-out of figures or an estimate
an account to be settled, as at an inn

explanation.surface: Adding up the total on an invoice.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dictionary senses: computing, and an account presented for payment.

clue.text: Furious pace causes bitterness at work

parts.note: gall is bitterness, from bile
op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A frantic pace at the office breeds resentment.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallop is a horse's fastest gait, so any very fast speed.

clue.text: Old TV show featuring boy with silver tongue

indicators.note: a show featuring someone has them inside it, so the boy and silver go within the show's title

parts.note: M*A*S*H was a long-running American TV comedy set in an army hospital
Al is a short boy's name
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A vintage television programme starring a boy with a silver tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: ALAG goes inside MASH. 'Silver tongue' reads as eloquence, but 'tongue' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Malagash is a variant name for Malagasy, the language spoken in Madagascar.

parts.note: an ad, advertisement, is a notice
en is French for in

explanation.surface: A notice posted in a French harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Aden is a major seaport in Yemen, at the mouth of the Red Sea.

indicators.note: dubious suggests the letters are unreliable, so they get rearranged
dismissed means the abbreviation for court is sent out of the word

explanation.surface: A questionable withdrawal is thrown out by the court.
explanation.walkthrough: RETRACTION without C and T leaves RETRAION, which 'Dubious' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Anterior means coming before, in time or position, so prior.

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first piece above the next
occasionally takes only some letters, here the second and fourth of the architect's name

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone sometimes saw Gaudí's buildings over the years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a past tense; it is the noun for a proverb. Antoni Gaudí was a Catalan architect.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb, a crossword-friendly synonym.

clue.text: Influence boy by favouring active involvement

parts.note: a hand is influence, as in having a hand in something
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A parent sways their son by getting stuck in.
explanation.definitionFit: A hands-on manager takes part directly rather than delegating.

clue.text: Expert regularly plays in a superior way

parts.note: arch can mean cunning or skilled, an expert in mischief

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the word plays

explanation.surface: An expert keeps playing in a way that shows superiority.
explanation.walkthrough: Every other letter of pLaYs gives LY.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting archly is acting with knowing condescension, in a teasing, superior manner.

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are British army soldiers
strain is stress or pressure

explanation.surface: An inspection for troops suffering from stress.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something is to hold it back, a synonym of curbing it.

clue.text: Arranged it with Gore taking power in an act of self-aggrandisement

indicators.note: taking means the shuffled letters are followed by an added piece
arranged means the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Al Gore set it up so he could seize power, out of vanity.
explanation.walkthrough: IT and GORE rearrange to EGOTRI. Al Gore was US vice-president.
explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is something done mainly to boost one's own self-importance.

clue.text: Complete as a result of embracing love

indicators.note: embracing means the phrase for consequence holds the love letter inside it

parts.note: through means by way of, as a result of
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A whole thing achieved because of loving it.
explanation.walkthrough: O goes inside THROUGH, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorough job is a complete one, with nothing left undone; the two are synonyms.

parts.note: reeds are tall grasses of wet places

explanation.surface: A survey of the varieties of grass found in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Breeds are types or varieties, especially of animals or plants.

parts.note: one's end is one's share, as in 'my end of the deal'
note means importance, as in a person of note

explanation.surface: Splitting the significance of something meant to help reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A note at the end of a book or chapter is a help to the reader.

indicators.note: uncovered strips the covering letters from each end of the word for a writer

parts.note: a scribe is a writer; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A writer's copy has been exposed as plagiarism.
explanation.walkthrough: SCRIBE loses its outside letters S and E.
explanation.definitionFit: To crib is to copy someone else's work dishonestly, as a schoolchild might.

clue.text: Attire son sports at opening night is uncommonly loud

indicators.note: sports suggests the letters are worn in a new arrangement, so they are rearranged
the opening of the word night is its first letter

explanation.surface: A son wears flashy clothes to a premiere and is very noisy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sports' rearranges ATTIRE SON to STENTORIA, then N comes from night.
explanation.definitionFit: Stentor was a Greek herald in the Iliad whose voice was as loud as fifty men's.

clue.text: Rash of insulting books on Independent politician

indicators.note: in a down clue on places the later words below the earlier ones

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament
rude means insulting
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: An outbreak of rude books about an independent politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rash' looks like a skin complaint; it is the adjective for reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash and reckless both describe acting without enough care or thought.

parts.note: a red is a socialist or communist
light means a way of seeing, as in 'in that light'

explanation.surface: A left-winger's opinion about brothels.
explanation.definitionFit: The red-light district is the area of a town where brothels are found.

clue.text: Constituent of Rayner ultimately needing it sorted out

indicators.note: sorted out means the letters are put into a different order
ultimately points to the final letter of the name Rayner

explanation.surface: A member of Angela Rayner's constituency needs something fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: R, the last letter of Rayner, is shuffled with NEEDING IT. Angela Rayner is a British Labour politician.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingredient is one component part of a mixture, a near synonym.

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a sight is a spectacle

explanation.surface: Know-how learnt from a crowd-pleasing show.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is a deep understanding of how something really works.

indicators.note: falling short means the word stops before its final letter

parts.note: to spank is to strike with an open hand

explanation.surface: A blow that fails to reach the bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: A span is the stretch of a bridge between supports, and as a verb to bridge a gap.

clue.text: Want journalist to catch Labour leader being heckled

indicators.note: to catch means the two pieces hold another letter between them

parts.note: need is want
ED, editor, is the crossword journalist

indicators.note: the leader of Labour is its first letter

explanation.surface: A reporter is eager to ambush the Labour leader with jeers.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or goad them, much like heckling.

definitions.meaning: straight, immediately, as in going straight home

explanation.surface: An instruction to act at once.
explanation.definitionFit: One word serves as a verb meaning command and an adverb meaning straight away.

clue.text: Slight reserve tense facing Bale? Not half

indicators.note: facing puts the earlier letters in front of the next piece

parts.note: a sub is a reserve player
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

indicators.note: not half keeps only the second half of the footballer's name Bale

explanation.surface: A footballer like Gareth Bale is slightly underused as a substitute, while tense.
explanation.walkthrough: The last half of BALE gives LE. 'Not half' is also British slang for 'very much'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something slight in degree is delicate or fine, as a subtle difference is.

clue.text: Sell for naira on board ship

indicators.note: on board means the currency letter is carried inside the vessel

parts.note: a brig is a two-masted sailing ship
N is the abbreviation for the naira, Nigeria's currency

explanation.surface: Trading currency aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: An item that sells for a price fetches it: 'it will bring a thousand'.

definitions.meaning: a pose deliberately struck, as by a dancer or a statue

explanation.surface: A careful stance hiding an awkward manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a bodily pose, and informally a truculent manner.

indicators.note: occupying means the letters sit inside the words felon endlessly

explanation.surface: A criminal endlessly stuck in solitary confinement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solitary' looks like the prison cell; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Lone and solitary both describe being alone, without companions.

parts.note: going means current or accepted, as in the going rate
a son is a relative; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A relative's strange behaviour has been tolerated.
explanation.definitionFit: Goings-on are odd or suspicious happenings, usually of doubtful propriety.

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing, so the word for complete holds the record

parts.note: real means complete or utter, as in a real fool
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A judge annuls an outright boxing result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxing record' looks like a fighter's tally.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeal a law is to set it aside or revoke it.

clue.text: Obtained back number at the same time

indicators.note: back means the word for obtained is read from right to left

parts.note: got means obtained
ether numbs, so it is a 'number', an anaesthetic

explanation.surface: A returned number received simultaneously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is read as 'something that numbs': ETHER, an old anaesthetic.
explanation.definitionFit: Things done together happen simultaneously, in unison.

clue.text: Began without resistance to become established

indicators.note: without means the letter for resistance is taken out

parts.note: started means began
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Something began unopposed and became settled.
explanation.definitionFit: A stated time or price is one fixed or settled in advance, so set up and agreed.
